summary: Hide and Seek is a multiplayer survival-horror game in Gullmouth Cannery, where hiders and player or bot mimics hunt, scavenge, and fight across an expanding dockyard. world.config.yaml and scripts/ui.js provide a character-selecting lobby menu and room discovery; places/main/sim.js referees rounds while player/bot behaviors own actions and shared templates, data, and generators supply gameplay and the arena.
places: places/main - Gullmouth yard now spans x -44..96 and z -36..100, including Fishermen's Row north and Rail Siding east; x0z0.scene places buildings, railway, cover, 26 loot crates, decoys, lamps, and hiding spots; config.yaml binds terrain, atmosphere, and decoration; sim.js referees rounds and publishes lobby state.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer world entry, arrival behavior, input bindings (including M/menu), touch surfaces, player/camera templates, and scripts/ui.js renderer.
sim.js - world-scope cadence/tick entry, separate from places/main/sim.js round referee.
places/main/sim.js - referee for lobby/hide/hunt/end, player draw, round entities, deaths, outcomes, and room lobby-board publishing.
templates/player.js#player and templates/camera.js#camera - player body composition and custom orbit camera roots.
places/main/config.yaml - main arena terrain, night lighting/atmosphere, look, and decorative layers.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - authored yard, north-row and east-rail additions, props, lamps, loot/decoys, cage, and hiding spots.
shared: scripts/lib/data/rules.yml - round, role, combat, reveal/start-lock, bot, hunger, recipe, and mimic power tunables consumed by referee/player/bot behaviors; huntSeconds is 420.
scripts/lib/data/dream.yml - dreamer dialogue/locations, clue data, and convince-game tuning read by referee/player; Pell and clues 3 and 6 are placed east.
scripts/lib/data/characters.yml - selectable own/dockhand/gutter/runaway/watch identities, display copy, avatar models, and portraits consumed by player.js and ui.js.
scripts/lib/sfx.js - named sound registry reused by game, round, NPC, and mimic-power behaviors.
scripts/gen/kit.js - geometry/material primitives reused by scripts/gen scene-prop and building generators.
templates/props.js - shared loot, decoy, disguise, trap, bait, lure, and fish-pile templates; tags/state distinguish their gameplay roles.
templates/dream.js#FAKE_NAMES and #fishermanForm - borrowed fisherman names and dreamer model/UI reused by human and bot mimic disguises; dreamer/clue templates also live here.
scripts/lib/data/player.yml and scripts/lib/data/camera.yml - locomotion defaults for humanoid-locomotion.js and initial settings for camera.js.
notableExports: places/main/sim.js - exports cadence, tick; sim.js - exports cadence, tick.
scripts/player.js - exports onInput, update; scripts/bot-mimic.js - exports updateSchedule, update.
scripts/dreamer.js - exports updateSchedule, update; scripts/clue.js - exports update.
scripts/flicker.js - exports updateSchedule, update; scripts/lamp-flicker.js - exports update.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - exports sit, onInput, update; scripts/camera.js - exports onInput, update.
scripts/arrival.js - exports onArrive, onLeave; scripts/ui.js - pick, play, join, fresh, openMenu, default; ui/nametag.js renders nametags.
scripts/controls.js - default touch-surface selector; scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - exports heightAt, materialAt.
templates/dream.js - exports dreamer, clue, fishermanForm, FAKE_NAMES; templates/creature.js exports mimicBody; scripts/gen/kit.js exports geometry helpers.
ownership: places/main/sim.js - ctx.place.state phase/timers, original mimicIds and draw/name, winner/feed/objectives/blackout/lastResult; assigns/reset roles, spawns round entities, judges traps/deaths/outcomes, and stores lobbies/roomId from SQL board polling.

scripts/player.js - each player's actions and role state: hp, inventory, disguise, reveal/ambush/claw lock, fish power/cooldowns, prompts/conversation/hiding and stun/root; also menu, joining, selected character, and cached original avatar model/wearing.
scripts/bot-mimic.js - spawned bot hunt mode/target, disguise/name, eating, fake loot, blackout/false clues, and attacks; food power scales chase/claw damage.
scripts/dreamer.js - NPC wandering/talker-facing/murmur and mimic detection; owns per-NPC warning line/cooldown and emits scream/shake.
scripts/ui.js - presentation only: reads phase/results/feed, room list, viewer role/health/inventory/prompt/power/menu/character state and renders HUD or main menu.
templates/props.js and placed objects - loot refill and fake/bait/trap/food state; scene hiding spots own occupant state; dream clues own taken/text/pic/owner state.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - avatar movement/animation/facing; reads player movement intent and pace.
scripts/camera.js - camera orbit behavior; templates/camera.js supplies initial camera state.
flows: places/main/sim.js tick → writes place phase/endsAt and player roles → scripts/player.js and scripts/bot-mimic.js gate actions; scripts/ui.js renders phase/results.
places/main/sim.js round start → reads scripts/lib/data/dream.yml and spawns templates/dream.js dreamers/clues plus templates/props.js#fishPile → dreamer.js/clue.js update them; player.js interacts.

scripts/player.js hider interact → claims clue or starts/judges dreamer conversation → updates clue taken/owner and dreamer awake/talker state → referee counts genuine clues and woken dreamers for objectives.
scripts/player.js attacks/crafts → writes damage or spawns traps/bait/lure/flash → places/main/sim.js judges traps and resolves deaths/win.
Round start in places/main/sim.js → player mimics spawn in hider ring with clawReadyAt from rules.yml reveal.startLock (30 s); player.js blocks claws until then and HUD shows countdown.
Human mimics start hidden among hiders → player.js witnessed-hit logic, traps/referee, or mimic wail reveal them; disguise/beast rendering, ui.js, and ui/nametag.js react to revealed/faded state.
places/main/sim.js hider death → resets that player as a revealed risen mimic; mimic death ghosts them, while original mimicIds determine true-seeker survival.
places/main/sim.js spawns tagged mimic-bot for solo rounds → bot-mimic.js reads hider rows, world objects/noise, and food to hunt; solo bot retains cage start.

scripts/player.js mimic eats templates/props.js#fishPile → increments state.power to unlock rules.yml powers; configured scent/lunge/wail/fade actions invoke them and fifth level passively heals on landed claws.
scripts/bot-mimic.js eats food → increments bot power, increasing bot chase/claw damage; bait/trap effects can reduce a player's mimic power by one.
Player/bot mimic powers → set blackout or plant false clues/fake loot → referee controls blackout; hider interactions treat false clues as harmful lies.

world.config.yaml menu action → player.js opens/picks/plays/joins/creates; ui.js renders characters and lobbies; each place referee posts room/count/phase to SQL lobbies every 4 s and reads recent rows; arrival.js opens menu on fresh arrival but skips it for menu-initiated cross.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/kit.js and scripts/gen/{boatshed,cannery,office,warehouse}.js - shared geometry kit builds walk-in structures; scene instances vary placement, child bulbs, and material, including the new salt/engine sheds and row buildings.

scripts/gen/{boat,dinghy,crane,container,drums,dumpster,fence,fish-crates,forklift,lamp-post,net-rack,pallets,pier,puddles,tarp,tyres,locker,fishpile}.js - scene-referenced dock, yard, rail-side, and hiding-place generators share kit helpers; fence perimeter and terrain bounds now extend east to x=96.
templates/props.js#FORMS - crate, barrel, and loot silhouettes reused for real loot, decoys, and mimic disguises; tags, physics, and state distinguish gameplay.
templates/dream.js#dreamer and #fishermanForm - mimic fisherman borrows sleeper model/UI and names; human/bot implementations vary in disguise and animation handling.
scripts/grass.js, scripts/pebble.js, scripts/reed.js - terrain decoration geometries bound in places/main/config.yaml; grass uses scripts/grass-look.js for material.
scripts/flicker.js and scripts/lamp-flicker.js - independent light behaviors: irregular bulb stutter versus burst-and-rest sodium lamp flicker.
scripts/lib/data/characters.yml entries - same selected character data drives menu cards and player avatar model; own falls back to the cached Spawn avatar.
migrationNotes: Round truth and win adjudication belong to places/main/sim.js in ctx.place.state; root sim.js is a separate world tick. Human mimics start in the hider ring with a 30 s claw lock; solo bot rounds still use the cage.

s.mimicIds records original seeker(s); risen mimics do not substitute for them in original-seeker survival checks. On original mimic disconnect, mask transfer and remaining-hider handling are referee logic.

Fresh arrival opens the menu; player.js marks menu-initiated room crosses with state.joining, and the referee excludes state.menu players from role draw. Its SQL lobbies board is room-scoped and considers rows fresh for 20 seconds.

Selected character model is applied by player.js; preserve state.avatarModel as the fallback when character is own. Mimic wears its picked character too until reveal; don't conflate chosen avatar with gameplay disguise.

Game timestamps are milliseconds (ctx.now() + seconds * 1000); dream convince period values are milliseconds, while rules durations/cooldowns and other values are annotated in seconds. Hunt is 420 seconds; fish hunger max remains 5 with 10 piles.

The arena spans x -44..96 and z -36..100: scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js, scripts/gen/fence.js, east scene placements, and east dream/loot coordinates align; the old inner fence at z=34 and east fence cuts are intentional.
